draft.text: You came in because you have a cough that was diagnosed as bronchitis, and a lung nodule was found on a chest x-ray.
We found a smooth, solitary lung nodule about 2 centimeters in size in the lateral part of your right upper lobe.
The nodule is described as smooth, and you hope it is benign.
You have no known risk factors for lung cancer, and your family history does not include lung cancer.
Further evaluation and imaging studies may be needed to better understand the nodule and decide on the next steps in your care.
